content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Shares Alaska telecom and cable services, but its core business is electric power generation and sales to remote communities."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Sells billing and network software and outsourced operations to telecom operators; it is a software vendor, not a connectivity provider."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Runs wireless, fixed broadband, voice and enterprise connectivity for consumers and businesses in rural and island markets, similar to the target."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Sells electricity and natural gas under utility rates to households and businesses, a different business from telecom services."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Core businesses are billboard advertising and insurance; its broadband arm is a small, separate segment, not the same business."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Sells cloud phone systems and web hosting mainly to small businesses, with no wireless or consumer cable offering."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Provides rural fiber internet, voice telephone, video and business network services to households and businesses, matching the target's broadband and cable mix."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Runs wireless service plus wireline broadband, phone and managed IT for consumers and businesses in rural and midsize markets, like the target."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Primarily leases fiber and copper network capacity to carriers as a real estate structure; retail broadband is a secondary line."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Core business is satellite connectivity and defense electronics manufacturing, with aviation and maritime focus, not terrestrial telecom service."}]}
